provenance.legend: Rows (instructions.<key>.mod_groups.<group>) may carry `_src`: a tag naming the measurement that produced or last repaired the row; `sources` below lists every tag in this table with its kind, date and, where it exists, the cubit tool and test that hold the evidence. `_note` on a row is the measurement in prose (bit positions, nvdisasm behaviour, what stays outside the row). Rows without `_src` are the 2026-06..08 harvest: fields learned from compiler output and validated by the round-trip census, not by per-field probes; their audit state is tracked in cubit's docs/KNOWN_ISSUES.md (tools/audit_table.py, tools/audit_dynamic.py). `history` keeps the fix-wave notes that used to be loose `_meta.bugNNN` keys, verbatim; `errata` keeps the former top-level `_errata_*` notes (sm121a). `_meta.key_aliases` maps retired key names to the key that carries the rows today (cubit resolves them for text and lookups, never prints them). Provenance is written once per level since 2026-11-08 (NEEDS 61): `instructions.<key>._src` is set when every row of the key carries the same tag (a row keeps its own `_src`; a row without one inherits the key's); the measurement note of a lattice family lives in `sources[<tag>].note` when every row of the tag shares it, on `instructions.<key>._note` when every row of the key shares it, and on the row only where the row's differs -- read a row's note as row `_note`, else key `_note`, else `sources[row's tag].note` (cubit `tools/tablefmt.py`: `row_src` / `row_note`). A field carries its own `_src` only when it was measured by another tag than its row. The file layout is tools/tablefmt.py's: compact JSON, one encoding row per line, indent=1 `_meta`.

barrier.description: Barrier / sync / membar — no scheduling bits

ctrl_flow.description: Control flow (BRA, CALL, RET, BSSY, BSYNC, etc.) — no standard scheduling

exit_static.description: EXIT — fully static ctrl word, bit43 required

ldc.description: 32-bit constant bank load — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

ldc64.description: 64-bit constant bank load — hi[11:8]=0xa is type discriminator

ldcu64.description: 64-bit uniform constant bank load — bit43=1 required

ldg.description: Global memory load (descriptor form) — lower 32 all fixed discriminators

lds.description: Shared memory load — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

nop.description: NOP — fully static, no write/wait mask allowed

s2r.description: System register read — hi[15:8] = SR code (opcode extension, not scheduling)

stg.description: Global memory store (descriptor form) — lower 32 all fixed, upper 32 has write/wait

sts.description: Shared memory store — hi[11:8]=0x8 is type discriminator

epoch_stg.comment: global store (write/wait in upper32 at non-standard offsets)

bandwidth_test.conclusion: HW compression (PTE Kind 0x8) is supported via cuMemCreate API but does NOT provide measurable bandwidth gain in streaming read benchmarks. Compression may only affect L2 effective capacity, not DRAM bandwidth. The 1.2-1.5x claim from PERF_FINDINGS is NOT confirmed.
bandwidth_test.result: NO measurable bandwidth difference between compressible and random data

ADD,E,GPU,STRONG._derived_note: GHOST ROW (iter33 audit, task-inherited from iter32): dead in decode -- every REDG word in corpus (vendor sm121 cubins, q1 library + q3 probes) renders desc[URx]; nvdisasm prints desc[UR0] even for a zeroed UR byte, so the plain desc-less text form these rows encode never occurs on hardware. Match pattern requires UR byte==0x08 (UR8 baked) + imm24==0, a strict subset of REDG_dARI_R (fields sub_ur0(64,8)/sub_imm2 subsumed); decoder dARI-preference penalty (decoder.rs plain_addr_penalty, REDG-scoped) routes all strict matches to REDG_dARI_R -- verified by sweep of UR byte 0..63 (64/64 -> REDG_dARI_R). Row retained for fleet-format parity with sm120.json (identical and_base/counts there); provenance suspicion: training records were pre-BUG-049/078 encoder artifacts (desc[UR4] silently baked to UR8). Residual scar: encoding desc-less REDG text still succeeds via this row and emits the UR8-baked word (silicon-harmless: desc DON'T-CARE for EA plain-atomics per iter32 probe) but cannot text-roundtrip vs nvdisasm. Evidence: results/q2/REDG_ARI_R_GHOST_AUDIT.md, tests/redg_ari_ghost.rs.
